title.zh: Treasury will let states file for stablecoin approval before finishing their rules
title.en: Treasury will let states file for stablecoin approval before finishing their rules

current_state.zh: Treasury's interim final rule lets states file conditional or incomplete stablecoin certifications to preserve their approval timeline while their legislative and regulatory work is finished, with full submissions required before substantive review and the 30-day decision clock begins.
